title: The Durable Frame · Phase 01

authorities.running: FORM Race Pace Durability remains canonical. This plan never rewrites running mileage, pace or session purpose.
authorities.strength: FORGE owns the authored strength prescription. Durable Frame is mirrored into the Forge catalog under the stable program id tinius_durable_frame_phase01_v1.
authorities.study: FORM Human Performance Study 004 interprets the interaction.

objective: Rebuild shoulders, upper back, upper chest, trunk definition and useful unilateral/posterior-chain strength without stealing quality from Tinius's running.
equipment_reported: October 6 athlete screenshot of current working loads received; Week 1 uses those loads as calibration context
equipment_pending: whether a stable chair / bench / step is available for optional rear-foot elevation

weekly_structure.timing: support slot after Tuesday is absorbed; if FORM Thursday quality is performed, reduce Lower + Core to trunk/calf only or skip the lower-body slots

global_rules: No bonus sets or optional finishers.
Equipment contract: adjustable kettlebell, small barbell + plates, yoga mat and bodyweight only. No cables, machines or bench dependency.
Tuesday's FORM key session owns the primary running question. Frame A is upper-dominant so it does not create lower-body debt.
Thursday strength is earned by Tuesday's absorption. Do not stack a full FORM Thursday quality session and a full Lower + Core session by default.
If FORM Thursday contains real quality, use only the authored trunk/calf support or skip lower-body strength; do not make it up later.
Keep 2-3 reps in reserve in Weeks 1-2; 1-2 reps in reserve on final sets of primary lifts in Weeks 3-4 only.
Week 1 starts from the athlete-reported working loads supplied October 6. Record actual load, reps and RIR; do not max test.
When all prescribed sets reach the top of the rep range with clean form and about two reps still available, add the smallest available load next exposure.
If available load cannot increase, use only the authored rep, tempo or leverage progression.
If strength begins to degrade Tuesday/Thursday/Saturday running for more than one week, reduce FORGE volume before changing FORM.

weeks.label: Establish
weeks.rule: Use the base set counts and the October 6 reported working loads as starting context. Record actual loads/reps/RIR. RIR ~3. No max testing.

weeks.label: Repeat
weeks.rule: Same set counts. Add reps or the smallest load only where Week 1 was clean. RIR 2-3.

weeks.label: Build
weeks.rule: Add one set to A1, A2, C1 and C2 only if running remains normal. Lower + Core set counts do not increase.

weeks.label: Hold
weeks.rule: Keep Week 3 volume. Progress load/reps only; no new exercises.

weeks.label: Absorb
weeks.rule: Reduce working sets by about 30%. Keep movement quality and leave running fresh.

weeks.label: Close
weeks.rule: Return to Week 4 set counts if absorbed. Compare loads/reps and comparable physique evidence. No max testing.

closeout: athlete report: frame, waist, freshness, interference

forge_delivery.rule: Existing Tinius access is additive. Do not issue a second code, remove Sculpt access, reset selection or rewrite closed-session history.
